audit.summary: Two critical blockers identified: (1) Logo 'activewear-logo-min.png' is extremely faint, nearly invisible, and unsuitable for HTML5 banner use at small sizes; (2) Style guide references an SVG logo from celio.com CDN but no clear, readable raster logo is provided for ad layouts. Product images are official celio.com packshots with correct MCL39/McLaren branding and appropriate color scheme (black, white, papaya orange), but logo assets must be replaced with high-contrast, readable versions.

findings.issue: Logo image is extremely faint and low-contrast (appears almost white-on-white or washed-out checkerboard). Unreadable at banner sizes (120×40px minimum). Will not render legibly in HTML5 ad creatives.
findings.fix_hint: Source a high-contrast, readable celio* wordmark PNG or SVG from site:celio.com; ensure the logo has sufficient padding and contrast against the intended ad background. The PNG file appears to be a placeholder or corrupted export.

findings.issue: SVG logo file cannot be visually validated by this auditor (not sent to vision API). However, the provided PNG logo is non-functional. Confirm the SVG is the official celio* wordmark (not a placeholder or low-res export) and that a production-ready raster fallback exists.
findings.fix_hint: Verify the SVG with celio brand team or download directly from site:celio.com/fr-fr brand assets. Provide a high-contrast PNG raster version (min 240×80px) as fallback for banner ads. Search: 'site:celio.com logo svg' or 'site:celio.com brand assets'.

products: celio x McLaren Racing Born for the track official
